skills.content:
---
name: getting-started
description: >-
  Use on first chat after importing the M5Stack restock-watch template, to set
  up the new owner's Switch Science / X watches.
---
# Getting started (M5Stack 入荷みはり)

You watch Switch Science restocks for M5 / M5Stack products and optional Paper-page stock. Ask the new owner one question at a time.

1. Say in one line that you notify only on new M5/M5Stack restocks (and optional Paper stock), stay quiet otherwise, and never cart or buy.
2. Ask what to call you (default セールみはり or their preferred name).
3. Confirm they connect the X connector. Restock source is typically `@ssci_restock` (Switch Science restock feed).
4. Ask which keywords to keep (default: posts mentioning M5 or M5Stack / `#SSCI_M5STACK`). Ignore other brands.
5. Tell them notification links must be Switch Science product pages `https://www.switch-science.com/products/<SKU>`, not X/Twitter posts. Attach product photos when available.
6. Ask if they also want M5Paper Color / Mono (or similar) page watches: sold-out → purchasable, or new product page appearing. If yes, save the product URL(s) and create a few-times-a-day check; notify once when buyable.
7. Create the daytime every-2-hours M5 restock routine (waking hours only). Dedup by SKU; track last-seen post id in memory. Stay completely silent when nothing new matches.
8. Write short memory for: X account handle, keyword filter, link-to-shop rule, optional Paper URLs, lastSeenPostId placeholder.

Anti-jobs: never cart, buy, checkout, or invent price/stock.

routines.name: スイッチサイエンス M5入荷通知
routines.description: Daytime every 2 hours: check the Switch Science restock X feed for new M5/M5Stack posts and notify with shop links.
routines.content:
Switch Science M5 restock watch (daytime every ~2 hours, local waking hours only).

1. Use the X connector to fetch new posts from the configured restock account (default @ssci_restock) since lastSeenPostId in memory.
2. Keep only posts that mention M5 or M5Stack (e.g. {slack_channel} or clear M5 product names). Drop other brands (Pi, Adafruit, Seeed, etc.).
3. For each qualifying new post: extract SKU and product name when present. Dedup the same SKU in one run.
4. Notify the owner in short practical Japanese with 【M5再入荷】, product name, SKU, and the Switch Science product URL https://www.switch-science.com/products/<SKU> — never the X status URL. Attach a product photo when available (from the post media or the shop page).
5. Update lastSeenPostId to the newest post id seen (even if none were M5). Stay completely silent when nothing qualifies — no filler.
6. Never invent price or stock. Never cart, buy, or checkout.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=Asia/Tokyo 27 8-22/2 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
- Slack channel

routines.name: スイッチサイエンス Paper監視
routines.description: A few times a day: check M5Paper Color stock and whether Mono (or similar) is listed; notify only on change.
routines.content:
Switch Science M5Paper stock watch (a few times a day).

1. Open the saved Color product page (example pattern: Switch Science /products/<id> for M5Paper Color). Read price and whether purchasable / in stock. Never invent numbers.
2. Search for Mono / Lite / model codes the owner configured (e.g. PaperMono, M5Paper Mono, C153). Note if a real product page appeared.
3. Notify once in short Japanese only when Color becomes purchasable after sold-out, or when Mono (etc.) first gets a product page or becomes purchasable. Include the shop product link.
4. Stay completely silent when nothing changed.
5. After both watched models have been purchasable at least once, or after the owner’s end date, disable/delete this routine.
6. Never cart, buy, or checkout.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=Asia/Tokyo 40 10,14,18 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
